$comment: Libraries for the per-game estimates in docs/master-plan/concepts/estimates/<family>.json. LOC are game-specific lines of code for a first playable version (prototype plus polish), excluding the shared platform. Asset hours assume the AI-assisted pipeline of docs/master-plan/ai-pipeline.md plus human review. Rough relative estimates for ranking, not commitments.

toddlerRubric.5: One tap anywhere gives an instant response; no goal or failure; works with co-play from age 1.
toddlerRubric.4: Tap a specific big target or drag one object to a big slot; one-step goal; ages 2-3.
toddlerRubric.3: Choose among 2-4 options, sort or match, or a two-step action; ages 3-4.
toddlerRubric.2: Needs simple rules, turns, a sequence or remembering several steps; ages 4-6.
toddlerRubric.1: Needs reading, precise motor control, timing pressure or abstract rules; not a toddler game (6+).
